name: Danganronpa R — Bada Wi-ui Hagwongwa Jeolmang-ui Sinipsaeng
original_name: 단간론파 R — 바다 위의 학원과 절망의 신입생
source:
Sixteen new students wake up in an academy, standing on a rock in the middle of the sea.
The vice principal, a penguin in a diving helmet, gives them one rule: kill someone without being found out, and you get to leave.
And when a murder happens, a Class Trial begins.

The protagonist, Haru Togakushi, remembers neither his talent nor how he came to the academy. The talent field in his e-Handbook shows only three question marks.

[From [url=https://woog91.itch.io/danganronpa-r]itch.io[/url]]
